summary: UI state-change handler with subscriber notification. Compares incoming state byte a2 against the current UI state via ByteFieldGetterAt100; when different, fires a vtable+44 notification with argument 1. Always dispatches StateChangeNotification, then activates (vtable+64 with 4) when a2 is non-zero, or deactivates via RangeCheck + ConditionalStateMachineDispatch when a2 is zero. Finally walks a subscriber linked list headed at this+0x90, invoking each node's vtable+56 with a2, advancing via StructFieldAccessor until the list ends.

operations.description: Guard on state difference: if (BYTE)a2 != ByteFieldGetterAt100(this), call the vtable+44 __stdcall notification with argument 1. The field obj+0x2C supplies the current UI state byte read by ByteFieldGetterAt100.
Dispatch StateChangeNotification(this, a2) unconditionally after the difference check.
Branch on a2: when non-zero take the activation path, otherwise the deactivation path.
Activation path: call the vtable+64 __thiscall virtual with (this, 4) and store its result as the return value.
Deactivation path: v4 = RangeCheck(this), then ConditionalStateMachineDispatch(this, v4); result stored as the return value.
Load the subscriber list head from this+0x90 into v5.
While the current subscriber node v5 is non-null, call its vtable+56 __thiscall virtual with a2, then advance v5 via StructFieldAccessor; iterate until the next-node value is null.
Return the last stored result v3 (activation/deactivation dispatch result, or last StructFieldAccessor value when the subscriber list was walked).
